texts.facts: These two claim petitions are filed by the respective petitioners U/s 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the common respondents, claiming compensation with respect to the injuries sustained by petitioner in Mvc 5018/2023 and death of deceased Brijesh @ V. Rijesh in Mvc No.5019/2023 in a road traffic accident.
texts.arguments: It is vehemently argued by the learned counsel for respondent no.2 that the accident in question has occurred in the middle of the road, on account of which the front portion of both the vehicles have got damaged and that at the time of accident, the rider of motorcycle i.e., deceased was not holding driving licence and both the deceased and injured who were traveling in the motorcycle were not in head gear hence the rider of motorcycle has also contributed negligence. SCCH-24 10 MVC 5018/2023 C/w 5019/2023 16. The petitioner has sustained grievous injuries and taken treatment for 2 days as inpatient. Hence the nature of injuries sustained by the petitioner which is grievous in nature it is reasonable to hold that period of two months as complete laid down period. 33. The petitioner at his age of 38 years has suffered grievous injuries.
